This 2020 Ford Ranger XLT in blue delivers capability and refinement for drivers who demand both on the job and on the weekend. The adaptive cruise control reduces fatigue during highway driving, while the forward sensing system helps you navigate traffic with increased awareness. Safety protection comes standard with dual front impact airbags and dual front side impact airbags, along with electronic stability control and traction control working together to maintain stability in challenging situations. ABS brakes with four-wheel disc brakes provide confidence at any speed, while low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about your vehicle's maintenance needs.

This Ranger XLT represents a well-rounded truck that balances capability, comfort, and technology. With locally owned and serviced history and the option for delivery anywhere, ownership becomes straightforward and accessible. Visit our showroom today and see why this truck deserves a place in your driveway.

This 2013 Ford F-150 Platinum in striking Red offers the capability and comfort you expect from a full-size truck with premium appointments throughout.

- Skid plates
- Power moonroof
- All-weather rubber floor mats
- Tailgate step
- Spray-in bed liner
- 5.0L V8 FFV engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD capability
- 3.55 electronic-locking rear axle ratio
- Ventilated front seats
- Premium Sony audio system with SiriusXM and DVD-Audio
- SYNC with MyFord Touch
- Navigation system
- High-Intensity Discharge headlights with automatic operation
- 20-inch polished aluminum wheels

The Platinum trim commands attention with its blend of rugged functionality and refined details. Heated front and rear seats provide comfort in cold weather, while the memory seat and pedal settings adjust automatically to your preference. The power-adjustable driver's seat features lumbar support, and ventilated front seats ensure comfort during extended drives. The overhead console with storage keeps essentials within reach, and the auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during nighttime driving.

Under the hood, the 5.0L V8 FFV engine delivers dependable performance paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission. The 4WD system with electronic-locking rear axle provides traction and control in varied terrain. Getting 14 MPG in the city and 19 on the highway, this truck balances capability with reasonable efficiency for its class.

The truck bed is equipped with a spray-in bed liner for lasting protection and durability. The tailgate step makes accessing the bed easier, while skid plates shield vital undercarriage components. Convenience features include a rear backup camera, rear parking sensors, and a trailer brake controller for safe towing operations. Rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions, and fog lights paired with HID headlights improve visibility in challenging conditions.

The Platinum package extends to safety with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain grip, while four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power. The security system and panic alarm offer peace of mind when you step away.

Premium touches define the interior, from black unique leather bucket seats to power windows and doors controlled with remote keyless entry. The Sony premium audio system includes 10 speakers, CD and DVD-Audio playback, and SiriusXM satellite radio. The SYNC system with MyFord Touch connects your devices for hands-free calling and audio streaming. Navigation assists with routing, while steering wheel-mounted controls keep conveniences at your fingertips.

Plus, for our out-of-state buyers, we offer nationwide shipping solutions to deliver your vehicle straight to your driveway. Distance and credit shouldn't stand between you and the right vehicle, and our team is here to handle every detail from paperwork to delivery.

Variably intermittent wipers, a tilt steering wheel, and electronic cruise control add to the day-to-day practicality of truck ownership. This Silverado 1500 Z71 represents solid truck engineering with the amenities that make ownership rewarding. We invite you to schedule a time to see it in person and discover what this capable truck can do for you.

description:
The 2001 Toyota Tundra SR5 Access Cab is a full-size pickup from Toyota's first Tundra generation. It is identified by the SR5 trim and the Access Cab body style, which gives it a two-door cab with additional rear seating space behind the front row. The truck uses the simple, durable proportions typical of early-2000s pickups, with a tall hood, upright windshield, and a bed that is separate from the passenger compartment. On the outside, the bodywork is straightforward and functional, with large side mirrors, clear glass, and a front fascia designed around Toyota's truck styling of the period. Access Cab models from this era are known for the extra rear access built into the cab area, and that detail is part of what distinguishes this version from a regular cab. The painted finish, wheel openings, and bed rails follow the clean, squared-off lines common to the model year.

Inside, the SR5 trim provides a more complete set of convenience equipment than the base versions of the truck. The cabin includes front bucket seating with a center console arrangement between the seats, along with a rear bench area accessible through the smaller rear doors. The dashboard uses large, easy-to-read controls and simple switchgear, which was common in Toyota trucks of this period. Air conditioning is part of the equipment on many SR5 examples, and the truck generally includes power steering and power brakes as standard equipment. Depending on the exact build, the instrument panel may also include factory gauges for vehicle speed, engine rpm, fuel level, and coolant temperature. Storage areas are built into the doors and the center portions of the interior, and the seating surfaces, trim panels, and headliner reflect Toyota's practical approach to light-truck interiors in the early 2000s. The driver sits high relative to the road, and the upright glass area gives a clear view forward and to the sides.

The Tundra line for 2001 was offered with Toyota's 4.7-liter V8 in many SR5 Access Cab trucks, and that engine is the most notable powerplant associated with the model. When paired with the automatic transmission commonly fitted to these trucks, it gives the pickup a smooth, uncomplicated driving character. Rear-wheel drive examples were sold, and four-wheel-drive versions were also available, depending on how the truck was originally equipped. The chassis uses a body-on-frame design, with independent front suspension and a solid rear axle arrangement typical of half-ton pickups of that era. Disc brakes were used at the front, with rear braking hardware matched to the truck's duty. Steering is by recirculating ball or similar truck-oriented hardware of the period, which is consistent with the model's size and intended use. The truck's powertrain and running gear were built to handle daily driving, towing, and hauling within the limits established by the factory equipment.

The bed area provides the working space expected of a pickup from this class, with a broad cargo floor, straight inner walls, and an open tailgate. Tie-down points and bed hardware may be present depending on how the vehicle was ordered and used, and the cargo box was offered in more than one length during this generation. The suspension tuning, wheel-and-tire selection, and frame construction give the Tundra a substantial feel on the road, while the Access Cab adds flexibility without changing the truck's fundamental job as a hauler. Exterior details on SR5 models can include color-keyed trim elements, step-style running boards on some trucks, and alloy wheels when specified, though each of those items depends on the individual vehicle. The truck's proportions, engine choice, and cab access arrangement give it the same straightforward character Toyota aimed for across the early Tundra range, with equipment that is easy to identify and use without added complexity.

This truck carries the hallmarks of Chevrolet's light-duty pickup tradition, featuring a rugged Fleetside pickup box and dark smoke gray bodyside moldings that provide a purposeful appearance. The 3.5L 5-cylinder engine delivers reliable performance paired with a 4-speed automatic transmission equipped with overdrive for efficient highway driving.

The split-folding rear seat increases interior flexibility for both passengers and cargo.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, occupant sensing technology, and 4-wheel antilock brakes to help maintain control in various driving conditions. The automatic rear locking differential enhances traction, while the front underbody shield protects vital components from road debris.

Entertainment and connectivity are covered with the XM Satellite Radio system featuring over 150 channels of commercial-free programming, plus an AM/FM radio and CD player through a 6-speaker system. This truck provides the entertainment options needed for long drives or daily commutes.

The exterior includes chrome bumpers, a color-keyed grille bar, and body-color front and rear fascias. Solar-ray deep-tinted glass reduces interior heat while maintaining visibility. The combination of practical features, solid construction, and genuine truck utility makes this Colorado LT a dependable choice for those seeking a midsize pickup with proven capability.
